title: jmap-chat-spec / crate-jmap: JMAP Chat properties for did_webvh member status and identity change (Mark's decision (3) on mimid-1wgh.4.81.27)
description: Split from mimid-1wgh.4.81.27 when part (1), the in-chat notice, was built (3cdc553). Part (3): proper JMAP Chat properties for did_webvh status per member (draft-atwood-mls-didwebvh-credential-01 §Negotiation SHOULD indicate which members are authenticated by did_webvh) and for an identity change, in jmap-chat-spec and crate-jmap. Each write to either needs Mark's OK on the text. mimid-agent-jmap then maps them; until then the notice Message and ChatContact.did (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.29) are what clients see.
close_reason: Done: jmap-chat-spec 1018d37 (didChangedAt, MAY) and crate-jmap 83a08405 (field, server-set, tests). Using it in mimid waits on the crate-jmap bump (mimid-1wgh.11.10).
